## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run test:unit` passes
- [ ] No API keys, tokens or `.env` files are included

### For glossary changes (delete if not a glossary change)

- [ ] Domain file(s) changed:
- [ ] `keep` terms are technical words, acronyms, product names or multi-word jargon, not ordinary English words
- [ ] Every new `annotate` / `translate` entry has text for each language it covers (`gu`), and `"reviewed": false`
- [ ] I did not mark my own rendering `"reviewed": true`
- [ ] I ran `npm run glossary:review` and committed `docs/GLOSSARY_REVIEW.md`
- [ ] Where the term comes from (optional): <!-- a standard, documentation, common usage -->

### For a glossary review (delete if not a review)

- [ ] I am a native speaker of: <!-- the language I reviewed, e.g. Gujarati -->
- [ ] I checked my language before marking it reviewed
